prompt:
Our maintenance team has a procurement list of 6 bearings currently used across various machines in our plant (see procurement_bearings.csv in the workspace). We need a supplier-agnostic substitution catalog so that our technicians can order replacement bearings from ANY of our approved vendors — not just the original supplier.

Please create a file named substitution_catalog.json that contains a structured entry for each bearing in the list. Each entry must include the correct inner bore diameter, the bearing type, the sealing configuration, and the equivalent model numbers from at least SKF, NSK, FAG, and NTN — using each brand's own naming conventions for seals and designations.

Also make sure the relevant entries in data/models/deep_groove.json and data/models/cylindrical.json are updated to include any bearings from the list that are not already in those files.

Note: the original model numbers in the CSV may be written inconsistently (spaces, missing dashes, etc.) — please normalize them.
